title: 第12幕绕后突袭第13幕第一滴血与第二滴血
content_zh:
第12幕 绕后突袭
“这可真是个好运气！”
邢辰不禁兴奋的笑出了声来，不过他之所以笑倒不是因为遇上了自己所希望的野怪而高兴，却是因为刚刚遭遇了人生中最黑暗一天的他终于有了点转运的迹象了。
对于末日使者来说如果想要拿一血，吃那些通常认为比较靠谱的人马或者大熊的成功率其实相当低，尤其是缺乏配合的路人局就更是如此。
由于两种踩地板的技能施法距离都比较近，末日使者又不像小鹿和陈之类是直接召唤，这就使得他缺了一个高级召唤生物高额的混乱攻击伤害输出，这种情况下如果没有强力队友支援的话几乎不可能拿到一血。
选择吃人马、大熊、巨魔之类拥有控制技能的野怪去拿一血，思路是尽可能的控制住敌人给自己输出的时间，而邢辰的思路却不同，他认为既然冰蛙把鹰身人加强的如此BUG，那么以前拿一血的老思路就可以改一改了。
鹰身人是很久之前改版新加入的一组小野，一家三口飞在空中的鹰身人，大姐大叫做鹰身女妖风暴巫师，攻击血量都不值一提，属于那种纯粹送钱送经验的野怪，绝大多数人根本懒得去理会这个野怪的数据，对这个野怪完完全全的不了解。
不过，身板孱弱其貌不扬的鹰身女妖风暴巫师却是全Dota法术输出最暴力的野怪！有一个全Dota前期最为BUG的神技——闪电链：投掷一道闪电对第一个敌人造成140点伤害，闪电一共跳跃4次。每次闪电跳跃会衰减25%的威力。
这个技能表面看上去没什么，140点的伤害大概相当于大多数英雄2级输出技能的伤害水平，更何况跳跃之后还会衰减，实在没啥意思。
但是，现在的问题是末日使者在大多数英雄技能伤害不会过百的1级时就能拥有了这个技能！也就是说末日使者1级就可以靠着它打出税前140点一次的魔伤！
这140点得魔伤虽然可观，但却也不是最主要的。
闪电链这个技能最让人看重的是它的冷却时间——仅仅只有变态的4秒！而且魔法消耗更是低到没有节操的50点！最后，它施法距离也长达900！可谓是真正意义上的法术机关枪！还是那种1级就能无限开火的越级技能！
和鹰身女妖风暴巫师闪电链的性价比比起来，绝大多数英雄5级之前能够学到的技能都弱爆了！
在出门1级英雄大都没鞋的情况下，想要从上路通常兵线相遇的转角处向下逃入近卫1塔的射程范围怎么也需要10秒以上，如果再加上一些卡位和限制技能就要花费更久了，这就给了末日打出4次闪电链共560点税前，420点税后魔法伤害的机会！
而脆皮一点的1级英雄一共满打满算也就四百来点的血，配合着如此恐怖的伤害，只要不是那种见面直接隐身的英雄，友军的英雄随便摸两下几乎是必然可以拿下一血的！
最后这560点的税前魔伤也只不过消耗200点魔法值罢了，有着灵魂之戒的末日完全可以轻松打出无压力。
对于吃到鹰身人的末日使者，邢辰拿一血的思路是你跑随便跑，我只要在你跑掉之前完成足够的输出便可以了。
而事实上除了极个别拥有牛X保命技能的几个英雄之外，真没有什么人能够在一两级时拥有足够的血量和移动速度来躲过闪电链末日使者的追杀。
所以，当邢辰控制着末日使者吃到鹰身人野怪的时候不禁有一种想要仰天长啸的感觉。
这一天对他来说实在是再糟糕不过了，先是硬着头皮在公司被领导给批了一顿请假回学校处理毕业事务，紧接着却收到了女友的分手短信，等到了晚上更是遭雷劈的莫名被拉入了这个死亡率异常高的天神游戏之中。

而现在，总算是转运了有木有！？虽然仅仅只是刷出一个鹰身人而已，可毕竟算是一个好的迹象。
“赶紧拿下这场战斗回去找个道士和尚什么的驱驱邪吧！听说北城观那里的道士有两把刷子。”
心中念叨着这些突然莫名其妙涌出来的稀奇古怪的念头，邢辰开启通讯联系上了江欣颖准备去线上拿杀人：“准备好等我过去。”
可是回答邢辰的却是一声哀鸣：“对不起……我……我迷路了……”
“迷路了……”邢辰哀叹一声。
邢辰无奈的叹了口气，虽然早已经对女孩的状况有了些心理准备，可是他还是没有想到居然会发生迷路这种事情。
不过想一想也是，对于仅仅接触过Dota一次的玩家来说不熟悉地图是难免的，自己最开始的时候也没少迷路，不过好在当时是在打AI并没有坑队友。
“你不要动，我去找你，然后你跟着我走就行了，一切听我的命令。”
“我……知道了……”
邢辰一脸无奈的汇合了江欣颖之后，立刻欺负对方没插眼，放心大胆的带着冰女从树林里绕到敌人的后面进行包抄。
一切就位，邢辰先躲在树林后面通过己方英雄共享的视野观察了一下情况——敌对方的遗忘法师和风行者正一直盯着前面的兵和暗痕的幻影刺客不放，丝毫没有意识到他们身后树林的阴影里还蹲着两个人。
真是突袭的绝好时机！邢辰扭头对江欣颖说了声“跟我来！”，然后便率先钻出了树林。
闪电链900的超远距离射程意味着邢辰的末日使者刚刚从树林里冲出便可以立刻使用技能进行攻击。
邢辰毫不犹豫，冲出树林后立刻使用了灵魂之戒的牺牲技能，用150点生命换取了150点的魔法，然后在右手一指，一道晴天霹雳瞬间从末日使者的手中发出，直射向仍然背对着他们毫无防范的风行者。
“轰！”
惨白的电光直接命中，风行者头顶上的血条立时掉了一大段！
闪电链进入CD状态，仅仅只需要等待4秒，第二次魔法就可以到来！
尽管已经遭受到了攻击，风行者和他的同伴骷髅法师却仍然浑然不觉的在和AI部队的小兵激斗着，似乎完全没有意识到刚刚到底发生了什么事情。
“这……这是不是应该夸奖他们注意力集中呢？”
邢辰看的一阵无语，不过动作却没有一丝的心慈手软，快速向风行者他们冲了过去，第二道闪电链也已经准备出手了。

…………
幻影刺客：出生于暗夜精灵的典狱长一族，由于受到暗夜主流社会的疏远，为了报复，Mortred发誓效忠天灾军团。她是力量和速度的完美结合，通过长年在阿森维尔森林的独处，学会了将身形融于周围的环境之中，每每在你最意想不到的时刻如幻影般出现。她精准而致命的攻击使她成为天灾军团极为重要的一员。这也就是为什么她被称为幻影刺客（PhantomAssassin）。
窒息之刃：对敌方单位造成少量神圣伤害并减缓其速度。对英雄造成的伤害减半。可被躲掉。可享受恩赐解脱的暴击几率/倍数。等级4:对普通单位造成180的伤害，降低50%的移动速度，持续4秒。施法消耗:15点魔法。
幻影突袭：闪烁到一个友方或敌方单位身边，如果是敌方单位则在攻击该目标时获得攻击速度加成。等级4:被动地提升100%的攻击速度。施法间隔:5秒。
模糊：当接近敌方英雄时，幻影刺客的身形变得模糊从而难以看清，并从敌方小地图上消失。部分敌人的攻击不能命中。模糊特效触发距离为1600。等级4:40%的几率闪避攻击。
终极技能恩赐解脱：幻影刺客修炼她的战斗技巧，有一定概率对敌方单位造成毁灭性的致命一击。等级3:有15%的几率造成450%伤害的致命一击。
content_en:
Act 12: Surprise attack from behind
"What good luck!"
Xing Chen couldn't help laughing excitedly, but the reason why he laughed was not because he was happy to meet the wild monster he hoped for, but because he finally had some signs of luck after having just encountered the darkest day in his life.
For the Doombringers, if they want to get first blood, the success rate of killing those horses or bears that are usually considered more reliable is actually quite low, especially in the passerby game that lacks cooperation.
Since the casting distance of the two floor-stepping skills is relatively short, and the Doombringer is not directly summoned like Xiaolu and Chen, this makes him lack the high chaotic attack damage output of a high-level summoned creature. In this case, it is almost impossible to get first blood without the support of strong teammates.
Choose wild monsters with control skills such as cannibals, giant bears, and trolls to get first blood. The idea is to control the enemy's output time for you as much as possible, but Xing Chen has a different idea. He believes that since the ice frog has strengthened the harpy with such a bug, the old idea of ​​​​getting first blood can be changed.
The harpies are a group of newly added wild monsters that were revised a long time ago. They are a family of three flying harpies. The eldest sister is called the harpy storm wizard. The attack HP is not worth mentioning. They are the kind of wild monsters that purely give money and experience. Most people are too lazy to pay attention to the data of this wild monster and have no understanding of this wild monster at all.
However, the frail and ugly Harpy Storm Wizard is the wild monster with the most violent spell output in Dota! There is one of the most buggy magic skills in Dota in the early stage - Chain Lightning: throwing a bolt of lightning will cause 140 points of damage to the first enemy, and the lightning will jump 4 times in total. Each lightning jump will reduce the power by 25%.
This skill doesn't look like much on the surface. The 140 points of damage is roughly equivalent to the damage level of most heroes' level 2 output skills, not to mention that it will decay after jumping, which is really meaningless.
However, the problem now is that the Doombringer can have this skill at level 1 when most hero skills do not damage more than 100! In other words, Doombringer can rely on it to deal 140 points of magic damage before tax at level 1!
Although these 140 points of magic damage are considerable, they are not the most important.
The most important thing about the Chain Lightning skill is its cooldown time - only an abnormal 4 seconds! Moreover, the mana consumption is as low as an unreasonable 50 points! Finally, its casting range is also up to 900! It can be said to be a magic machine gun in the true sense! It’s still the kind of leapfrogging skill that allows unlimited fire at level 1!
Compared with the cost-effectiveness of Harpy Storm Wizard Chain Lightning, most of the skills that heroes can learn before level 5 are extremely weak!
When most level 1 heroes go out without shoes, it will take more than 10 seconds to escape from the corner where the troops usually meet on the top lane and into the range of the 1st Guards Tower. If you add some blocking and restricted skills, it will take even longer. This gives Doomsday the opportunity to play 4 times of chain lightning for a total of 560 points of pre-tax and 420 points of magic damage after tax!
The squishier level 1 heroes only have about 400 points of health at full play. With such terrifying damage, as long as they are not the kind of heroes who are invisible directly when they meet, an friendly hero can almost certainly get first blood with just two touches!
In the end, the 560 points of magic damage before tax only consume 200 magic points. Doomsday with the Soul Ring can be easily played without any pressure.
For the Doombringer who eats the Harpy, Xing Chen's idea of ​​getting first blood is that you can run as much as you want, and I just need to complete enough output before you run away.
In fact, except for a few heroes with excellent life-saving skills, there is really no one who can have enough health and movement at one or two levels.Speed ​​to avoid the pursuit of chain lightning doomsday messenger.
Therefore, when Xing Chen controlled the Doomsday Messenger to eat the harpy wild monster, he couldn't help but feel like looking up to the sky and screaming.
This day could not have been worse for him. First, he had to go to the company and was approved by his boss to take a leave of absence to go back to school to deal with graduation matters. Then he received a breakup text message from his girlfriend. At night, he was struck by lightning and was inexplicably pulled into this god's game with an unusually high mortality rate.
But now, it’s finally changed! ? Although it only spawned a harpy, it was still a good sign.
"Quickly win this battle and go back to find a Taoist monk or something to drive away evil spirits! I heard that the Taoist priests at Beicheng Temple have two brushes."
With these strange thoughts that suddenly came out of nowhere in his mind, Xing Chen opened the communication and contacted Jiang Xinying, preparing to go online to kill someone: "Be ready and wait for me to come over."
But Xing Chen's answer was a cry: "I'm sorry...I...I'm lost..."
"Lost..." Xing Chen lamented.
Xing Chen sighed helplessly. Although he had already been mentally prepared for the girl's condition, he still did not expect that he would get lost.
But think about it, for players who have only been exposed to Dota once, it is inevitable that they are not familiar with the map. I often got lost at the beginning, but fortunately I was playing AI at the time and did not cheat my teammates.
"Don't move. I'll go find you. Then you just follow me and follow my orders."
"I...got it..."
After Xing Chen joined Jiang Xinying with a look of helplessness, he immediately bullied the other party into not standing in the way, and confidently and boldly led Ice Girl from the woods to the enemy's back to outflank them.
With everything in place, Xing Chen first hid behind the woods and observed the situation through the vision shared by his own heroes - the enemy's Forgotten Mage and Windrunner were staring at the soldiers in front and the Phantom Assassin of Dark Mark, without realizing that there were two more people squatting in the shadow of the woods behind them.
What a perfect time to pounce! Xing Chen turned to Jiang Xinying and said, "Follow me!" and then took the lead to get out of the woods.
The ultra-long range of Chain Lightning 900 means that Xing Chen's Doombringers can use their skills to attack as soon as they burst out of the woods.
Xing Chen did not hesitate. After rushing out of the woods, he immediately used the Sacrifice Skill of the Soul Ring, exchanging 150 points of life for 150 points of magic. Then with a finger of his right hand, a bolt of lightning instantly erupted from the hand of the Doomsday Messenger, directly towards Windrunner, who was still facing them without any defense.
"Boom!"
The pale electric light hit directly, and the health bar above Windrunner's head immediately dropped a large section!
The lightning chain enters the CD state, and you only need to wait 4 seconds for the second magic to arrive!
Although they had been attacked, Windrunner and his companion Skeleton Mage were still fighting fiercely with the AI ​​soldiers without realizing it, seemingly unaware of what had just happened.
"This...should I praise them for their concentration?"
Xing Chen was speechless for a while, but there was no mercy in his movements. He quickly rushed towards Wind Walker and the others, and the second lightning chain was already ready to take action.

Phantom Assassin: The Warden clan was born in the night elves. Due to being alienated from the mainstream night society, Mortred swore allegiance to the Scourge in order to retaliate. She is the perfect combination of strength and speed. Through years of solitude in the Ashenville Forest, she has learned to blend her figure into the surrounding environment, appearing like a phantom at the most unexpected moments. Her precise and deadly attacks make her an extremely important member of the Scourge. That's why she's called the Phantom AssassintomAssassin).
Choking Blade: Causes a small amount of Holy damage to enemy units and slows them down. Damage dealt to heroes is halved. Can be avoided. You can enjoy the critical hit chance/multiplier of the gift of relief. Level 4: Causes 180 damage to ordinary units and reduces movement speed by 50% for 4 seconds. Casting cost: 15 magic points.
Phantom Assault: Blink to a friendly or enemy unit. If it is an enemy unit, it will gain an attack speed bonus when attacking the target. Level 4: Passively increases attack speed by 100%. Casting interval: 5 seconds.
Blur: When approaching an enemy hero, the Phantom Assassin's figure becomes blurred, making it difficult to see clearly, and disappears from the enemy's mini-map. Some enemies' attacks cannot hit. The blur effect trigger distance is 1600. Level 4: 40% chance to dodge attacks.
The ultimate skill is the gift of liberation: Phantom Assassin practices her combat skills and has a certain probability of causing a devastating fatal blow to enemy units. Level 3: 15% chance of causing a critical hit of 450% damage.
